citations.claim: Total energy at initial state defines E0 baseline
Energy just before violation is within bound, then jumps above allowed 1836.5J
First violation: total energy exceeds E0+10%+5J with no controller work
Light body gains large lateral and upward velocity after joint impact

explanation: Two circles fall together under g=30 with dt=1/30. At step 21 both fall at ~21.3 m/s (body0 at y~0.53 touching floor, body1 above at y~2.03). At step 22 they undergo near-simultaneous floor bounce and mutual circle-circle collision. The impulse plus positional correction for overlapping contacts injects ~200J (energy 1683->1884J) with zero controller work, exceeding the 1836.5J bound. Likely sequential impulse solver double-counts / over-corrects simultaneous contacts.
vision_note: Two blue circles fall almost vertically together toward the bottom edge from steps 19 to 21. At step 22 the lower circle reaches the floor and the pair suddenly separates laterally instead of continuing a vertical fall and bounce.
